assets.prompt:

Input images: Image 1 supplies rendering language only. Image 2 supplies incorporeal-humanoid line, shape, translucency, cloth, and detail handling only. Do not inherit identity, objects, composition, palette, lighting, weather, or mood.

Constraints: no ghost duplicates, horror pose, glow aura, magic symbols, fire effects, dramatic lighting, text, watermark, extra figures, heads, tools, or limbs.

qa.notes: Complete recognizable ancestor with restrained translucency and one craft tool.
